checks: Each boundary row is a coordinate row, so it contributes nothing off the diagonal of Q. Each other row is entrywise nonnegative with nonpositive W_z, hence Q_ij≤0 for i≠j.
The positive vector t makes diag(t) invertible and Qt=0 gives L1=0. The diagonal is the sum of incident positive edge weights. Expanding the edge squares gives the exact quadratic form.

The energy vanishes exactly on vectors constant on connected components, including isolated vertices. The nullspace follows either from semidefiniteness or by direct row expansion. Transforming Qt(θ)=0 by the same diagonal scaling gives the stated ratios.
For a row supported in one component the common ratio factors out with coefficient Σ_i H_zi t_i. A row spanning several components is a sum of their profiles, as the proof records.

overlap.comparison: The accepted stress gives positivity and annihilation on a guarded active kernel. The graph extraction additionally assumes a particular free-coordinate interpolation and signs at nonboundary rows and derives the component description.

readability: The interpolation rows need only their stated nonnegative coefficients for the algebra. The conclusion about a row uses its actual support.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The interpolation sign condition produces a diagonally scaled graph Laplacian. Its connected components give exactly the nullspace and curvature profile ratios.
